controls.L1: Centres camera / replace weapon / buy business

evidence.On foot/Triangle: pdf3 (printed 3) On Foot: Triangle button - ENTER VEHICLES
evidence.On foot/Circle: pdf3 (printed 3): Circle button - SHOOT; pdf6 (printed 9): Circle button to fire
evidence.On foot/Cross: pdf3 (printed 3): X button - SPRINT; pdf5 (printed 7): press and hold X button to run faster
evidence.On foot/L2: pdf3 (printed 3): L2 button - WEAPON SELECT; R1 row: (L2 / R2 to switch targets)
evidence.On foot/L1: pdf3 (printed 3): L1 button - CENTRES CAMERA, REPLACE CURRENT WEAPON, BUY BUSINESS (or house icon); pdf6 (printed 9): press L1 button to replace your current selection
evidence.On foot/R2: pdf3 (printed 3): R2 button - WEAPON SELECT; R1 row: (L2 / R2 to switch targets)
evidence.On foot/R1: pdf3 (printed 3): R1 button - TARGET LOCK-ON; pdf6 (printed 9): R1 button to target
evidence.On foot/Up/Down/Left/Right: pdf3 (printed 3): Up, Down, Right, Left buttons - MOVE AROUND
evidence.On foot/Select: pdf3 (printed 3): SELECT button - TOGGLE CAMERA VIEW
evidence.In vehicle/Triangle: pdf3 (printed 3) In Vehicle: Triangle button - EXIT VEHICLES
evidence.In vehicle/Cross: pdf3 (printed 3): X button - ACCELERATE (ASCEND in helicopter); pdf5 (printed 7) Helicopter: X button: Ascend
evidence.In vehicle/Square: pdf3 (printed 3): Square button - BRAKE (DESCEND in helicopter); pdf5 (printed 7) Helicopter: Square button: Descend
evidence.In vehicle/L2: pdf3 (printed 3): L2 button - LEFT LOOK (ROTATE LEFT in helicopter); pdf5 (printed 7) Helicopter: R2 & L2 buttons: Rotation
evidence.In vehicle/L1: pdf3 (printed 3): L1 button - CHANGE RADIO STATIONS
evidence.In vehicle/R2: pdf3 (printed 3): R2 button - RIGHT LOOK (ROTATE RIGHT in helicopter); pdf5 (printed 7) Helicopter: R2 & L2 buttons: Rotation
evidence.In vehicle/L2+R2: pdf3 (printed 3): R2 & L2 buttons - (pressed together) LOOK BEHIND
evidence.In vehicle/Up/Down/Left/Right: pdf3 (printed 3): Up, Down, Right, Left buttons - STEER
evidence.In vehicle/Select: pdf3 (printed 3): SELECT button - TOGGLE CAMERA VIEW
evidence.In vehicle/R3: pdf3 (printed 3): R3 button - TOGGLE VEHICLE MISSIONS ON or OFF
